reasons.balancer-c-exposed-mechanism: B is a more resolved and intentional balancer: matching side plates with slots, visible fasteners, a properly mounted board stack and detailed hub wheels make an ordered exposed mechanism, while A has blank disc wheels, a vague open frame and a small module that looks stuck onto a shelf.
reasons.balancer-d-product-shell: B is an open-frame balancer whose side plates, shelves, board, battery and IMU are deliberately arranged and look like they carry load, while A is the disliked archetype: a soft, rounded pillow box with a visor face and dot eyes sitting on wheels.
reasons.balancer-e-hard-surface: B is a crisp hard-surface enclosure with chamfered volumes, bolted panels and properly detailed hubbed wheels, so it reads as one considered object; A's open frame is sparse and vague, with plain disc wheels, no visible drive motors, and a small board that looks stuck onto its shelf.
reasons.balancer-f-creature: B is a clear, intentional balancing robot: a chamfered side-plate frame with cut-outs carries the board, sensor and battery on purpose-built shelves, so the structure looks load-carrying, whereas A is a soft, rounded owl with eyes, horns and a stuck-on wing, a committed character but one with the face and pillow-like form this owner dislikes.
reasons.balancer-h-free: A is an open, purposeful balancer frame with the boards, IMU and battery deliberately placed on chamfered side plates, while B is the disliked archetype: a soft, pillow-like rounded box with a visor and dot eyes sitting between its wheels.
